# skills — agent bootstrap (llms.txt)

> A single static Go binary that manages Agent Skills (SKILL.md folders) on a
> developer machine: catalog, selective install, profiles, per-repo scoping,
> LLM quality audits, secret scanning, usage telemetry, and prompt→skill
> routing. This file is the **bootstrap entrypoint for an AI agent**: follow
> it top to bottom to install the tool, load its operating knowledge, and
> start managing skills. Everything linked below is in this repo.

## What this is

`skills` treats skills the way a package manager treats packages. Source of
truth is a catalog dir (`~/.skills/`); installs are symlinks into the harness
dir (`~/.claude/skills/`) so edits propagate live; selection (tags,
categories, named profiles) replaces install-everything; per-repo scoping
copies real committable files into `<repo>/.claude/skills/`.

## Install (verify, then trust)

    curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ab0t-com/skill-cli/main/install.sh | sh
    skills setup

The installer is POSIX sh, HTTPS-only, and refuses to install without a
sha256 match against release/checksums.txt. Binary: linux-amd64.

## Load your operating knowledge (in order)

1. skills/skill-cli-for-agents/SKILL.md — usage patterns + decision rules
   for agent runtime use. Read this FIRST.
2. docs/AGENT-API.txt — the runtime-safe command subset (`skills agent`):
   discover/similar/manifest/list/log/prompt-render, all with --json.
3. skills/skill-manager/SKILL.md — the full operator manual (install,
   doctor, snapshots, audit, secrets, prompt library) when you need to act
   as the curator, not just the consumer.
4. docs/COMMANDS.txt — complete verb reference (`skills help`).

## Agent runtime rules (the contract)

- Read-only verbs are safe: `manifest`, `list --json`, `similar --json`,
  `discover --json`, `log --json`, `prompt render/body/show`.
- `skills manifest` is cheap — cache it once per session.
- Do NOT loop mutating verbs (install/remove/scan/add/rename/audit/...) —
  those are curator commands; ask the human.
- Errors: non-zero exit + `{"error": ...}` on stderr. Check both.
- `skills fired <name>` exists for harness hooks, not for you to call by hand.

## Typical agent call chain

    decision=$(skills discover "$USER_PROMPT" --json)        # route
    skills similar "$(echo "$decision" | jq -r '.selected_skills[0].name')" --json
    skills prompt render <template> --vars '{"k":"v"}'        # hydrate a template

## Repo map

- release/        the binary + VERSION + checksums.txt (sha256)
- install.sh      verified installer (read it before piping to sh)
- skills/         operating knowledge as Agent Skills (also: install them)
- docs/           generated command reference (COMMANDS.txt, AGENT-API.txt)
- LICENSE         MIT
